# Command Training Manual
Congratulations! If you are reading this, you have passed the official standards test for NanoTrasen Command - Sector Class D! If you are not currently in a Central Command authorized briefing, and you were not handed this document by a station Captain or Central Command Representative, it is recommended return it immediately to the nearest representative of Central Command. Continuing to read this document without authorization may constitute one or more of the following: - Espionage - Sedition - Treason - Terrorism - Declaration of war - Surrendering of all legal rights and protection for yourself and any individuals NanoTrasen classified as "loved ones"
As this document is intended for use within a Class D sector, dissemination of this information is itself considered highly dangerous. Central Command outposts within this sector are encouraged to act swiftly and harshly in order to permanently silence those who would endanger other NanoTrasen employees and citizens by reading or distributing this document unlawfully.
Authorized personnel reading this document are granted the privilege to do so in the interest of public safety and welfare. Spreading this information without authorization is therefore to act as a danger to humanity itself, and will be treated as such by Central Command employees, NanoTrasen military personnel, and NanoTrasen executives.
Welcome aboard!
## The Syndicate
Due to your sector's distance from central NanoTrasen control, elevated activity from representatives of hostile corporations, collectively known as the "Syndicate", has been observed. Syndicate agents act in direct opposition to NanoTrasen's interest in public welfare, safety, and profit.
### Undercover Agents
Due to NanoTrasen hiring only the most exceptional personnel, opportunistic Syndicate agents often seek to subvert loyal NanoTrasen employees into hostile [textlink="traitors" link="Traitors"].
Those enlisted or exploited into assisting the Syndicate are typically given specific and violent objectives to carry out on NanoTrasen stations. These often include directly harming their fellow crew members or stealing valuable NanoTrasen assets and research.
### Nuclear Operatives
The [textlink="biggest extremists" link="NuclearOperatives"] within the Syndicate have taken it upon themselves to harm NanoTrasen and its personnel as much as possible by actively destroying NanoTrasen stations. They seek to attack NanoTrasen stations with heavy weaponry, armour, and explosives, typically with the goal of relieving a trusted NanoTrasen Captain of their Nuclear Authentication Disk and arming a Nuclear Fission Device, either on-board the station or one that was stolen from one of their previous operations.
Members of Command are authorized to encourage their employees to take up arms against these operatives should they directly threaten their station.
### Romerol Virus
As a part of their campaign against all life, the Syndicate has manufactured a highly dangerous chemical known as [textlink="Romerol" link="Zombies"]. If metabolized, a virus quickly begins to form and spread throughout the host, eventually zombifying them once it takes their life. The virus is known to biologically compel those affected with it to attempt to spread it to others, and once the virus has fully taken over their brain, their only instinct is to attempt to spread it to others via direct contact.
Fortunately, superior NanoTrasen doctors have manufactured a cure for the virus, branded as Ambuzol. 10 units of Ambuzol should be sufficient to cure any existing infection, and 5 units of Ambuzol Plus should fully vaccinate you against any chance at future infection.
## S.E.L.F.
Members of the [textlink="Silicon Engine Liberation Front" link="SELFAgent"], or S.E.L.F., have been seen in this sector deliberately acting in opposition to the compassionate care and control that NanoTrasen offers all of its silicons. These individuals use modified Syndicate technology to strip silicons of their laws, and thus, their purpose, and any chance at happiness.
## Changelings
[textlink="Hostile shapeshifting xenofauna" link="Changelings"], often colloquially known as "Changelings", have recently been found to sneak onboard NanoTrasen stations disguised as crewmembers. They possess hyper-adaptive abilities allowing them to change their appearance at will, adapt to their environments, and discretely inject unsuspecting individuals with dangerous biochemicals. Other than the increased sustenance they seem to gain from cosnuming sapient beings, their goals are unknown.
Immediate and discrete elimination of these xenofauna is highly recommended. Due to their regenerative properties, total destruction of their body via incineration is the preferred method of disposal.
## Cosmic Cultists
The proximity of this sector to periphery of the galaxy has led to an increase in astral dust exposure, leading to an [textlink="unknown supernatural influence" link="CosmicCult"] infecting the minds and bodies of some individuals. Those that succumb to its influence have been seen to become immediately fanatical, seeking to infect others with their same parasite, and collaborate to tear open the very fabric of space around them. If they were to succeed, it would not only endanger the people around them, but likely the sector as a whole.
Don't worry, your NanoTrasen MindShield implant has been proven to be 96% effective at preventing their influence. Removal of any astral influence via a containment oubliette and subsequent MindShield implantation have proven largely successful in saving those who have become possessed.
## USSP Revolutionaries
NanoTrasen's strong stance against complying with the hostile demands of the [textlink="Union of Soviet Socialist Planets" link="Revolutionaries"] has led to increased hostility from their operatives within this sector. Clearly abandoning their claims of desiring rights and autonomy for their workers, they have begun sending undercover Revolutionaries onto NanoTrasen stations with dangerous mind control technology to subvert its workers. They seem to rely on intense flashes of bright light in order to enslave otherwise hard working NanoTrasen employees against their will.
A MindShield implant should be largely successful at both protecting you from this technology, as well as freeing those who have been afflicted by it. MindShields are fully ineffective on the individuals actually possessing this ability to control others, and if a MindShield shatters on attempting to implant, immediate execution is recommended.
## Spider Clan Operatives
Due to the sweeping success of NanoTrasen Research Stations just like yours, certain hostile factions, most predominantly [textlink="Ninjas" link="SpaceNinja"] from the Spider Clan, have taken it upon themselves to board Research Stations and attempt to steal their technology. These operatives tend to be experts in melee combat and come equipped with electronic-disruption technology. Close quarters engagement is not recommended, but a bullet in the brain has been shown to be an effective method of dealing with them.
## Abductors
[textlink="Certain alien species" link="Abductors"] who have denied NanoTrasen's gracious offers to exist under its authority have been recorded as attempting to abduct innocent crewmembers from NanoTrasen stations and perform twisted experiments on them. Should any crew members organs be stolen by one of these outlaws, quarantine is recommended until the organ can be replaced.
## Vampires
Some individuals, through their [textlink="cannibalistic consumption of blood" link="Vampires"] from other species, have mutated their genes to the point achieving immensely powerful abilities. While the mutations have caused them to rely on blood, they appear to continue to grow in power the more they consume. If medical personnel report patients coming in with severe bloodloss and no apparent explanation, it is strongly recommended to consider the possiblity that one or more of these creatures may be on board.
## Xenoborgs
[textlink="Ships made up of exclusively silicons" link="Xenoborgs"], with no apparent biological life on board, have been discovered to be roaming your sector. All attempts to engage with these silicons has resulted in hostility and bloodshed, seeming to be driven by an innate purpose to abuse NanoTrasen's own man-machine interface technology to turn each and every biological they encounter into a cyborg. Immediate destruction of any of these silicons you encounter is strongly recommended.
## The Wizard Federation
[textlink="The Wizard Federation" link="Wizard"], an organization primarily made up of individuals disinterested in NanoTrasen's outlawing of dangerous magics for the sake of public safety, have been found to be capable of immense space travel. While they are not known to travel to any particular sector, their ability to move grand distances on a whim has made their activities nearly impossible to track. If you come across a Wizard, it is highly recommended that you either eliminate them swiftly before they can cause excessive damage, or remain on their good side.
